newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. 1,221 MW Palo Verde nuke shut for refueling.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. 1,221 MW Palo Verde nuke shut for refueling.

text.p: Arizona Public Service Co's 1,221 megawatt (MW) Palo Verde nuclear power unit 3 was shut down over the weekend, as scheduled, for refueling and maintenance, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit was taken off line Feb 22 and was in a cold shutdown mode early Monday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Palo Verde 3, located in Wintersburg, Ariz., was expected to be shut for about 50 days for the work.
The NRC gave a tentative restart date for the unit of April 3.
The adjacent Palo Verde nuclear power units 1 and 2, each also with a capacity of 1,221 MW, continued to operate normally at full power, the NRC said.
Arizona Public Service Co is a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital Corp.
